instruction: Access and play movies from your Vudu digital library using VLC media player.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because Vudu uses DRM protection on all digital content. The service does not provide downloadable files that can be played in third-party players like VLC, and streaming URLs are encrypted with DRM.
